sources.verified_angle_summary: Blossom Accelerator has been officially named the Soft-Landing Partner for LEAP 2026, offering a dedicated pathway for international startups expanding into Saudi Arabia. The partnership provides founders with priority access, tailored support for market entry, and expedited processes for obtaining the Ministry of Investment (MISA) Entrepreneurship Registration Certificate, often within 30 days. Blossom’s program also connects startups with the National Technology Development Program (NTDP) for potential grants and subsidies. During LEAP 2026, Blossom will host a closed-door workshop led by Founder & CEO Emon Shakoor, detailing the practical steps of company setup, regulatory requirements, and securing corporate partnerships in the Kingdom. This angle is distinct as it focuses specifically on the structured, official soft-landing mechanism provided by Blossom at LEAP 2026, rather than general event scale or broad investment figures.
sources.verified_key_facts: Blossom Accelerator is the Official Soft-Landing Partner for LEAP 2026; Offers expedited 30-day processing for the MISA Entrepreneurship Registration Certificate at no initial cost for vetted startups; Connects founders with NTDP programs like MVPLab and Transform+ for grants up to 800,000 SAR; Blossom Founder & CEO Emon Shakoor will lead a dedicated workshop at LEAP 2026 on market entry and contracting; Blossom has previously helped over 100 businesses from 15 countries expand into Saudi Arabia.
